1.d4 f5 2.Qd3 d5 3.g4.strategy: Attacks f5 a second time, with pawn and queen against the single defence of the bishop, so Black must settle the tension at once. A tricky gambit: White opens lines at the cost of a loosened kingside, and a pawn.
1.d4 f5 2.Qd3 d5 3.g4.name: Dutch Defence: Manhattan Gambit, Anti-Stonewall
